# Anita Jewellery - full details

Anita Jewellery is a home-based jewellery shop at Athokpam Mayai Leikai, Thoubal, Manipur 795138, selling home to home since 2009. It sells readymade gold-plated and imitation jewellery - not real gold. Delivery is available across the valley areas of Manipur.

Website: https://anitajewellery.github.io/
WhatsApp bookings: +91 8014998953
Address: Anita Jewellery, Athokpam Mayai Leikai, Thoubal, Near Phura Keithel - 795138, Manipur, India

## How to buy

There is no online checkout. To buy a piece, open its page on the website and tap "Book on WhatsApp" - bookings are taken personally on WhatsApp at +91 8014998953. Payment is by cash or UPI.

## Delivery

Home delivery across the valley areas of Manipur. The shop is home-based and has sold home to home since 2009; there is no shopfront and no fixed opening hours.
